name: PunisherFinTheme
overview: Selectable, accent-aware designs for Jellyfin Web.
description: Offers complete PunisherFin and Cinema Deck designs for cards, episodes, details, previews, and players while preserving Jellyfin's native behavior.

versions.changelog: Adds a persistent English/German language selector to the PunisherFinTheme settings page, with English as the default. All option labels, design previews, background controls, live slider values, library and preview states, dependency status messages, and error dialogs switch immediately while preserving unsaved settings and are saved with the plugin configuration.

Extends the global accent color to Jellyfin search fields, search suggestions, focus and selection states, all five artwork-placeholder variants used by people and studios, legacy active control groups, and remaining playback/OSD progress elements. Missing actor and studio artwork now keeps Jellyfin's visual variants while deriving every background from the configured accent color.
